illustration.description: Minimal line-art illustration of a standing adult human figure viewed from the front, arms relaxed at sides with hands near the hips, drawn with a uniform thick black outline and no interior shading or fill; the figure is centered and neutral in pose. Overlaid are two thin orange-yellow horizontal measurement guides: a long horizontal line across the torso at elbow height, and two short vertical bracket lines on each side from that level down to the wrist/hand level, indicating the distance between elbow and hand. Clean white background, flat vector-icon style, high contrast, simple and diagrammatic.

graphics.description: Horizontal measurement guide line spanning across the torso at elbow level
Two vertical measurement bracket lines on left and right sides, each with short horizontal end caps, spanning from elbow level to wrist/hand level
